title: EstimateFairPriceRequest
description: Checkpoint C.2.1 request contract for the estimate_fair_price MCP tool. Looks up ONE existing historical listing by its stable dataset id and returns the same fair-price estimate search_stays would compute for that listing -- never accepts arbitrary caller-supplied model features, coordinates, or property attributes. A stay_id absent from the current pinned snapshot is NOT_FOUND (STAY_NOT_FOUND), never silently substituted or interpolated. currency is fixed to the model's one accepted currency (TRY), matching SearchStaysRequest's own currency field -- no conversion contract exists yet, so no other value is accepted.

stay_id.description: The stable dataset id of an existing listing in the current pinned historical snapshot -- the same value returned as stays[].stay.stay_id by search_stays. Never a raw feature vector, model input, or arbitrary caller-constructed listing.
